description: PrintGenerator helps users search public vocabulary lists and their own UserBook lists from ChatGPT. It supports vocabulary details, flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, and study using remembered or unremembered words. When needed, it can also create a share link to open a list in the Flutter app.
